episode_spec.instruction: Walk forward across the living room, keeping the white sofa on your left. Continue past the large television and turn right through the doorway ahead. Enter the dining room and stop at the dining table with the chairs.
episode_spec.start_yaw_note: yaw -pi/2 faces +X: living room, white sectional sofa on the left, television on the right wall. Previewed as runs/preview2_obs/p2_a_start_00000_rgb.png before freezing.
episode_spec.target_note: Dining table with chairs, previewed as runs/preview2_obs/p2_e_00004_rgb.png before freezing.
episode_spec.sensor_config_source: scripts/eval/configs/vln_r2r.yaml (640x480, hfov 79, forward 0.25 m, turn 15 deg, tilt 15 deg, depth 0-10 m); model_max_depth 5.0 from habitat_vln_evaluator.py look_down_depth clamp
episode_spec.intrinsic_note: fx = fy = width / (2 tan(hfov/2)) computed by the worker from the frozen sensor config; reported by the sim worker 'info' command.
episode_spec.exposure_note: Run v1 fed the raw render (mean luma 39.9) and the model never committed to a route. The released real-world fixtures average luma 118.6, so v2 applies a per-frame auto-exposure gain (clipped to 4x) to the MODEL INPUT ONLY, emulating a real RGB-D camera. Saved observation PNGs remain the raw render. Habitat DEFAULT_LIGHTING_KEY was tested first and made it worse (luma 18.5).
